product.name: WEEX Futures Trading
product.description: A cryptocurrency derivatives platform for trading futures contracts, including perpetual contracts, with leveraged exposure to digital assets.

product.name: WEEX Spot Trading
product.description: A digital-asset exchange service for buying and selling cryptocurrencies directly through spot markets.

product.name: WEEX Markets
product.description: A market-information and trading-access service that provides cryptocurrency prices, trading pairs, market statistics, and gainers data.

product.name: WEEX Copy Trade
product.description: A social trading service that allows users to follow and replicate selected cryptocurrency traders’ positions and trading activity.

product.name: WEEX Earn
product.description: A digital-asset yield service for earning returns on eligible cryptocurrency holdings through products offered within the WEEX platform.

product.name: WEEX OTC
product.description: An over-the-counter cryptocurrency trading service for arranging digital-asset purchases and sales outside the standard exchange order book.
